name: Dot Voting / Heatmapping
deliverable: Visual distribution of group attention across ideas without groupthink

steps.text: Give each person five dots for the ideas.
Choose privately before anyone reaches the wall.
Walk the wall silently and place dots without comment.
Circle the three densest clusters, not the loudest.
Let each cluster's author explain the mechanism.

failure: Bandwagon voting: waiting for leadership, people pile on, so heat measures hierarchy.
intervention: Stop the wall, have everyone write choices on paper first, and hide cursors and counts until the timer ends.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.note: Widely used in facilitation practice; no single documented originator.
